thread:
Amy (support): Hey team — ACME reported repeated p95/p99 latency spikes starting ~16:20 UTC, several requests 500ing. They attached a request_id: rq-0a7f3. Their app shows timeouts and retries. Customer is on shared-dedicated pool 3. They're seeing GPU OOMs in our sidecar logs.
Devon (eng-runtime): Thanks Amy. Any sample traces or logs? Which model and seq length?
Amy (support): Model: redwood-3-xl, avg seq ~1200 but tail to 4k with some customers. Attached error snippet from the tenant pod:
```
2026-03-16T16:22:41Z ERROR allocator: failed allocate 2147483648 bytes: OOM
stack: runtime.go:112
kv_evict_count=0
```
Devon (eng-runtime): kv_evict_count=0 is suspicious — looks like KV growth but evictions didn't run. @saira can we pull slab/kv metrics for that pool (pool=shared-dedicated-3)?
Saira (eng-sre): On it. Quick query:
```
sum by (pool) (rate(kv_store_bytes_total{pool="shared-dedicated-3"}[5m]))
```
returned a spike ~2.6GB/5m starting 16:15. slab_frag_pct for same pool climbed from 18% -> 67%.
Mike (support): Customer says they didn't change workload. This started after a midnight rollout we did last week? Could be an optimizer tweak.
Zoe (eng-runtime): We rolled allocator patch r-2026-03-10 to reduce compaction frequency. That could increase fragmentation under heavy long-sequence workloads. Repro attempt: hitting a test tenant with sequence mix, I see slab fragmentation rising after sustained 80 concurrent streams.
Devon (eng-runtime): Immediate mitigation options:
- move the tenant to another pool with lower load (manual routing decision)
- force shorter model variant (redwood-3-medium) for that tenant via routing override
- trigger a controlled process restart for the affected pods (will free GPU memory and compact)
Which do we want to try first? @amy can you ask ACME if they can tolerate a short restart?
Amy (support): ACME okay with a maintenance window 30m from now.
Saira (eng-sre): I'll do conservative mitigations in order:
1) bump eviction aggressiveness for pool (kv.eviction_policy=aggressive)
2) enable immediate compaction flag on affected nodes: `allocator.compact_now=true`
3) if still failing, migrate tenant to pool-7 (lower density)
Executing step 1 now.
infra-bot: action=update_config target=pool/shared-dedicated-3 kv.eviction_policy=aggressive user=saira status=ok
Saira (eng-sre): Eviction rate increased, seeing kv_evict_count incrementing. slab_frag_pct stabilizing at ~45% and p95 latency dropping from 420ms -> 210ms in next 90s.
Devon (eng-runtime): Great. Still want a controlled restart to defragment kernel allocations — schedule at t+10m if metrics not back to baseline.
Zoe (eng-runtime): For longer-term: revert the reduced compaction patch or make compaction demand-driven when slab_frag_pct > 50% and kv_growth_rate > X. Also add an emergency fallback to route heavy-tail tenants to smaller sequence variants automatically.
Mike (support): Noted. Customer wants a writeup of what happened and what we changed.
Amy (support): I'll send ACME a postmortem summary after we finish mitigation. Quick checklist for PM and infra follow-ups?
Devon (eng-runtime): Follow-ups:
- Add alert: `kv_growth_rate > 1GB/5m && slab_frag_pct > 50%` => auto page eng-runtime
- Add instrumentation: per-tenant kv_eviction_count and per-pool compaction events to the tenant dashboard
- Evaluate allocator patch revert / tuning
Saira (eng-sre): Also add a runbook step to prefer eviction over immediate restart unless eviction_count remains zero for >2m — that was key here.
Zoe (eng-runtime): One more immediate temporary tweak: apply `alloc.max_reserved_kv=1GB` for the tenant to cap unhealthy growth and force eviction earlier. Applying now.
infra-bot: action=update_config target=tenant/acme alloc.max_reserved_kv=1GB user=zoe status=ok
Saira (eng-sre): After cap, kv_store_bytes_total rate reduced and p99 latency back near baseline (p99 820ms -> 260ms over 5m). No more OOMs observed in last 6 minutes.
Amy (support): ACME notified and okay with the cap while we implement long term fix. They appreciated the quick update :thumbsup:
Devon (eng-runtime): Next steps for engineering ticket:
- ENG-RUNTIME-2412: fallback compaction policy + revert evaluation of r-2026-03-10
- ENG-RUNTIME-2413: per-tenant eviction telemetry and auto-routing rules for hot tails
- ENG-INFRA-1090: allocator defensive defaults and `compact_now` review
I'll file and assign.
Mike (support): Can we add a short repro snippet so support can hit this in staging? Maybe a loader script that'll emulate tail requests (4k tokens) at concurrency 60+.
Zoe (eng-runtime): I'll drop a small script in #eng-runtime-staging and tag y'all. Use model redwood-3-xl, seq 4k, concurrency 60, sustained 10m.
Amy (support): Thanks everyone. I'll close the support escalation once the tickets are linked and ACME has the postmortem.
Devon (eng-runtime): Thanks — saved by eviction + cap. We'll keep monitoring. :eyes:
